menu--spartan.reason: brain has no menu primitive; Spartan's dropdown menu is a styled wrapper over `@angular/cdk/menu` (the Angular CDK column).

listbox--spartan.reason: brain has no standalone listbox; listbox roles exist only inside its combobox, select and command widgets.

combobox--angular-cdk.reason: `@angular/cdk` has no combobox; the experimental one ships separately in `@angular/cdk-experimental`.

dialog--angular-aria.reason: No dialog entry point; the Angular team points to `@angular/cdk/dialog` (the Angular CDK column).
